name: Computer Age Management Services Ltd
about: The company is a mutual funds transfer agency. It provides investor services, distributor services and asset management companies (AMC) services.

items.quote: We have said that we will try to exit the year with a close to 20% profitability.
And you've seen also from an expense growth perspective, we had guided in the initial part of the year that we will try to keep it less than 10%.
And as we said, our target is to get to 20% within the next couple of years.
You should expect the payment business in the next 2 years to grow about late 20s, 30% each year in the next 2 years.
We expect, therefore, that non-MF growth will stay blended upwards of 20%.
So we believe that for the year, overall blended non-MF revenue will certainly be 20%.
But if you normalize that for going forward increase in revenue, I think we are well on track for this 20% plus growth in non-mutual fund.
I would kind of say that it will not be kind of 20%, but you should expect probably 17% kind of a margin.

items.quote: So 10% revenue growth, 13.5% EBITDA growth, 14.5% PAT growth, that's really the summary of the quarter.

claims.summary: All 4 company-wide figures management read out on the last 2 calls match the reported results.
claims.note: Each figure management read out on the call is recomputed from the quarterly results the company filed, consolidated and standalone, with EBITDA both before and after other income. A figure is only called a mismatch when the call clearly speaks about the whole company.

checks.title: Profit turns into cash
checks.text: Over the last 3 years operating cash flow was 114% of reported profit, so profit is turning into cash.

checks.title: Customers pay on time
checks.text: Customers now take 14 days to pay, against 12 three years ago.

checks.title: Profit comes from the core business
checks.text: Other income (interest, investment gains, one-offs) was 8% of pre-tax profit in the last 12 months. The core business earns most of the profit.

checks.title: Profit growth backed by operations
checks.text: In FY26, net profit grew 2% while operating profit grew 5%.

checks.title: Tax rate is normal
checks.text: Tax rate in Sep 2026 was 25%, against 25% on average over the four quarters before.

checks.title: No one-off boost this quarter
checks.text: No unusual jump in other income in Sep 2026.

checks.title: Debt under control
checks.text: Debt is 0.04× equity, against 0.08× two years earlier.
